# Week 4 guide

This week you finish the project so that someone who has never seen it can use it.

1. Complete your `README.md` with three sections: Setup, Usage and Limits. Limits says plainly what
   the assistant cannot do or gets wrong.
2. Check that the demo link still works from a different computer or network.
3. Write a final reflection on what you would change if you started again and what you learned.
